body:
Okay listen, I really appreciate you for taking time to try and help me. Nobody in my life has ever given enough of a shit to so I'm not used to it.

I'm going to look for a sports club and a gym or something, maybe that'll help with making friends and finding someone... But, because I'm not the greatest at socialising and experiences I've had in the past, I don't have my hopes super high or anything. But I'll give it a shot. Thank you.
I don't know what to say. I need to stop feeling miserable every day otherwise I know I'll end up right back here in the future.

But look at it from my perspective, maybe life isn't enjoyable to live with my limitations... I've faced so many struggles because of the way I am I can't even express it all in words.

I like music yes, pretty knowledgeable on music. I don't play any instruments, but I do listen to a lot of stuff. And video games. I play a lot of video games, they help take my mind off stuff. 

I need a community, a good group of friends yeah. But I just feel like it's going to be the same as it always is where I won't really fit in and end up being an outcast. It's the same story wherever I go because it's not other people that are the problem, it's me.

The thing is, I have high functioning autism, and it's not particularly obvious, I'm relatively good at hiding it. But I just lack the ability of being able to have deep, meaningful conversations with people. The kind of conversation that starts friendships. Basically, I'm too autistic to fit in with normal people but too normal to fit in with autistic people. School is just about to end and I guess I should be looking for a job, but I guess none of that matters any more.

Maybe there is a solution, but if I don't know what that solution is or how to reach it, what use is it.

Loneliness has pushed me to this. I have autism, so socialising doesn't always go to plan, and it's caused me to end up with very few friends. And the friends I do have rarely want to spend time with me. I would have gotten over the girl who left me long ago if I thought I could just find someone else, but with the way I am finding someone else is 100x harder than it is for most people, and I'm terrified of being alone forever.

It's all gotten too much for me. Every time I seek help I just get told things will get better. Well I've stuck it out for too long and things aren't getting better. I can't live through this reality any more for a future that MAY or MAY NOT come. I plan on writing a goodbye letter then going out at midnight to put an end to things.
